title: motion-strip zoom override is silently ignored out-of-band, while the CLI caller rejects the same value as a usage error
detail: Invalid zoom_override falls back to demo.zoom with no error, but main.odin:212 rejects it via usage(). Today only main.odin:229 calls this proc (verified), so no bad value is reachable; a future caller gets wrong-altitude evidence silently.
recommended_fix: Make the fallback explicit: return an error (or clamp-and-log) for out-of-band zoom_override in run_motion_strip, so the contract does not depend on the caller validating first.
